changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Every action carries the authorization generation of its workspace when it was queued, and keeps it (KR-10, ADR 0134). An action whose write the send boundary refuses ends AUTHORITY_CHANGED. Existing actions were queued at generation 0. The column keeps the default of generation 0 for a writer of the previous release: such an action is refused once any narrowing happened, never allowed. The checks are added without validation, so their row scan runs outside the exclusive schema lock.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Validate the action checks while ordinary row writes can continue.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE agent_action VALIDATE CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_stop_reason; ALTER TABLE agent_action VALIDATE CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_authorization_stamp;

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A person has an authorization generation on their account, which only a narrowing of what the person may have done raises (KR-10, ADR 0134 decision 1). Every account starts at generation 0. A narrowing is an AI choice that changes to NO_AI, from CLOUD to IN_HOUSE_ONLY, from no choice to any choice, or back to no choice; an instance role that is taken away; and an account that stops being active, by a block or an erasure. A change of the AI choice from no choice counts, because a workspace where choosing is optional admits a model that a first choice can rule out. The trigger is installed with the column, whoever writes the row. Neither generation can fall: a stamp that a narrowing made stale must stay stale.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE account ADD COLUMN authority_generation bigint DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_account_authority_generation CHECK (authority_generation >= 0); CREATE FUNCTION person_narrows_authority() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE public.account SET authority_generation = authority_generation + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id; RETURN NULL; END $$; -- AFTER, not BEFORE: a BEFORE row trigger makes PostgreSQL lock the row FOR UPDATE whenever an UPDATE lists a key -- column, as an entity flush does, and that lock blocks every foreign key check on the account until commit. -- The inner UPDATE lists none of these columns, so it does not fire the trigger again. CREATE TRIGGER account_narrows_authority AFTER UPDATE OF ai_choice, app_role, status ON public.account FOR EACH ROW WHEN ( (NEW.ai_choice IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ai_choice AND (OLD.ai_choice IS NULL OR NEW.ai_choice IS NULL OR NEW.ai_choice = 'NO_AI' OR (NEW.ai_choice = 'IN_HOUSE_ONLY' AND OLD.ai_choice = 'CLOUD'))) OR (OLD.app_role = 'APP_ADMIN' AND NEW.app_role <> 'APP_ADMIN') OR (OLD.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NEW.status <> 'ACTIVE')) EXECUTE FUNCTION person_narrows_authority(); -- A CHECK cannot compare a row with its old version, so a trigger refuses a generation that falls. CREATE FUNCTION authority_generation_only_rises() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'An authorization generation never falls: % % from % to %', TG_TABLE_NAME, OLD.id, OLD.authority_generation, NEW.authority_generation USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation'; END $$; CREATE TRIGGER account_authority_generation_only_rises AFTER UPDATE OF authority_generation ON public.account FOR EACH ROW WHEN (NEW.authority_generation < OLD.authority_generation) EXECUTE FUNCTION authority_generation_only_rises(); CREATE TRIGGER workspace_authority_generation_only_rises AFTER UPDATE OF authority_generation ON public.workspace FOR EACH ROW WHEN (NEW.authority_generation < OLD.authority_generation) EXECUTE FUNCTION authority_generation_only_rises();

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A stamp also holds the generation of each person whose authority the work depends on, such as a review's developers or a turn's owner, under "accounts". Unfinished work from before the upgrade gets the person it names at generation 0, where every person starts: a feedback send its developer, a Slack reply its asker, a weekly digest email its reader, and a turn or digest its conversation's owner. A review's developers are not stored with its run; its model calls still check each developer's current AI choice, and its feedback is stamped when it is queued. The checks are added without validation, so their row scan runs outside the exclusive schema lock.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Validate the stamp checks while ordinary row writes can continue. A rollback runs the change sets of this file newest first and starts here, so it refuses before it changes anything while an action records that its access changed.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE agent_run VALIDATE CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_authorization_stamp; ALTER TABLE agent_action VALIDATE CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_authorization_stamp;
